item.description:
iPod Connect 1.7.0

Fixes the most common reason a Rockbox install fails on a Mac.

  • Mac-formatted iPods are now detected. An iPod set up on a Mac carries an Apple partition map, and Rockbox's bootloader only reads a PC (MBR) one. The bootloader would install cleanly and then stop at "No partition found", with nothing explaining why. The app now spots this before you flash anything and tells you what is wrong.
  • New: Convert to FAT32. Rewrites the partition map and reformats the music partition in one step, which is the only thing that actually fixes a Mac-formatted iPod. Formatting alone could not: it works inside the existing partition map and leaves it in place, so the disk kept looking correct while staying unbootable. Your firmware partition is left alone, so a bootloader already installed survives.
  • Quality column in the song list and the Cover Flow listing, showing bit depth and sample rate for lossless files, or bitrate for everything else.
  • The Artists column can be dragged to resize, instead of being stuck at one width.
  • Updates are silent now. New versions download in the background and apply on the next launch, with no dialog for routine updates. You can still check manually from the iPod Connect menu.
